agent_explanation: Elastic ceiling bounce with large dt (0.0287) and high vy (~40 m/s) causes energy gain. Step1 vy after bounce magnitude 40.73 > 40.47 initial, speed rises from 41.42 to 41.68. Subsequent falling steps gravity accelerates but total mechanical energy (PE+KE) should remain constant for e=1; instead energy grows from 971.96 (E0) to 973.07 to 1031.7 to 1092.7, exceeding 10% tolerance by step3. Smaller dt avoids gain, indicating positional correction / impulse in substep loop adds energy when dt is large and body penetrates arena boundary before correction.
